import json, pathlib, subprocess, sys
          source = json.loads(pathlib.Path('scripts/libbox-patches/source-manifest.json').read_text())
          core = json.loads(pathlib.Path('src-tauri/core-manifest.json').read_text())
          directory = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
          def revision(repository, ref):
              return subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(repository), 'rev-parse', ref], text=True).strip()
          def fetch(url, commit, name):
              repository = directory / name
              repository.mkdir()  # Refuse stale runner checkouts; every input is fetched fresh.
              subprocess.run(['git', 'init', '--quiet', str(repository)], check=True)
              ref = 'refs/heads/polaris-source'
              subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(repository), 'fetch', '--no-tags', '--depth=1', url, commit + ':' + ref], check=True)
              if revision(repository, commit + '^{commit}') != commit or revision(repository, ref) != commit:
                  raise RuntimeError('Fetched upstream object/ref differs from manifest pin: ' + name)
              return repository
          url = source.get('sourceURL', 'https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box')
          repository = fetch(url, source['sourceCommit'], 'sing-box')
          tag = 'refs/tags/v' + core['bundledCoreVersion']
          subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(repository), 'fetch', '--no-tags', '--depth=1', url, tag + ':' + tag], check=True)
          if revision(repository, tag + '^{commit}') != source['sourceCommit']:
              raise RuntimeError('Upstream version tag differs from source-manifest commit')
          subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(repository), 'checkout', '--detach', source['sourceCommit']], check=True)
          values = []
          for dependency in source['dependencyPatches']:
              repository = fetch(dependency['sourceURL'], dependency['upstreamCommit'], 'polaris-upstream-' + dependency['name'])
              values.append('--module-source=' + dependency['module'] + '=' + str(repository))
          (directory / 'polaris-module-sources.json').write_text(json.dumps(values))

identity:
id: libbox_input
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 scripts/libbox-patches/android-source.py admit
          libbox_go="$(command -v go)"
          libbox_ndk="$(python3 scripts/libbox-patches/prepare-ndk-linux.py "$RUNNER_TEMP")"
          export LIBBOX_GO="$libbox_go" LIBBOX_NDK_HOME="$libbox_ndk"
          mobile_version="$(node -p 'require("./scripts/libbox-patches/source-manifest.json").gomobileVersion')"
          GOBIN="$HOME/go/bin" GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOWORK=off go install "github.com/sagernet/gomobile/cmd/gomobile@$mobile_version" "github.com/sagernet/gomobile/cmd/gobind@$mobile_version"
          echo "LIBBOX_GO=$libbox_go" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "LIBBOX_NDK_HOME=$libbox_ndk" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          fingerprint="$(python3 scripts/libbox-patches/android-source.py identity)"
          [[ "$fingerprint" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]]
          echo "fingerprint=$fingerprint" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
build:
if: steps.libbox.outputs.cache-hit != 'true'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          app_status="$(git status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"
          if [ -n "$app_status" ]; then
            echo "::error::App source candidate must be clean before libbox build"
            git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all
            exit 1
          fi
          src="$RUNNER_TEMP/sing-box"
          # Fetch exact upstream objects, not patched candidateCommit or only the default branch.
          # A named ref keeps the pinned core reachable in the provider's shared clone.
          python3 - "$RUNNER_TEMP" <<'PYDEPS'
          import json, pathlib, subprocess, sys
          source = json.loads(pathlib.Path('scripts/libbox-patches/source-manifest.json').read_text())
          core = json.loads(pathlib.Path('src-tauri/core-manifest.json').read_text())
          directory = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
          def revision(repository, ref):
              return subprocess.check_output(['git', '-C', str(repository), 'rev-parse', ref], text=True).strip()
          def fetch(url, commit, name):
              repository = directory / name
              repository.mkdir()  # Refuse stale runner checkouts; every input is fetched fresh.
              subprocess.run(['git', 'init', '--quiet', str(repository)], check=True)
              ref = 'refs/heads/polaris-source'
              subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(repository), 'fetch', '--no-tags', '--depth=1', url, commit + ':' + ref], check=True)
              if revision(repository, commit + '^{commit}') != commit or revision(repository, ref) != commit:
                  raise RuntimeError('Fetched upstream object/ref differs from manifest pin: ' + name)
              return repository
          url = source.get('sourceURL', 'https://github.com/SagerNet/sing-box')
          repository = fetch(url, source['sourceCommit'], 'sing-box')
          tag = 'refs/tags/v' + core['bundledCoreVersion']
          subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(repository), 'fetch', '--no-tags', '--depth=1', url, tag + ':' + tag], check=True)
          if revision(repository, tag + '^{commit}') != source['sourceCommit']:
              raise RuntimeError('Upstream version tag differs from source-manifest commit')
          subprocess.run(['git', '-C', str(repository), 'checkout', '--detach', source['sourceCommit']], check=True)
          values = []
          for dependency in source['dependencyPatches']:
              repository = fetch(dependency['sourceURL'], dependency['upstreamCommit'], 'polaris-upstream-' + dependency['name'])
              values.append('--module-source=' + dependency['module'] + '=' + str(repository))
          (directory / 'polaris-module-sources.json').write_text(json.dumps(values))
          PYDEPS
          (cd "$src" && GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOWORK=off go mod download all)
          mkdir -p "$HOME/Code"  # build.py clones the pinned source into a fresh checkout here.
          df -h / | tail -1
          mapfile -t module_sources < <(python3 -c 'import json,os; [print(value) for value in json.load(open(os.environ["RUNNER_TEMP"] + "/polaris-module-sources.json"))]')
          bash scripts/build-libbox.sh "$src" "${module_sources[@]}"

          # 🔴 腾磁盘再交给 Rust 那一步。本机实测这次构建产生 **7.4 GB** Go 构建缓存
          # （加 module cache 更多），而同一个 job 后面还要放 Rust 的 android target 目录与 release
          # APK。GitHub runner 的系统盘余量有限，且爆盘的报错形态（链接器
          # 中途 ENOSPC）离真因很远。这里的缓存对本 job 之后的步骤零价值 —— 要的是那个 aar，
          # 它已经落在 app/libs/ 下并会被 actions/cache 保存。
          go clean -cache -modcache || true
          rm -rf "$src" /var/tmp/gomobile-tmp
          df -h / | tail -1
